sections.subheading: Sofas, beds, dining and storage from our own workshop. See them in the showroom, or tell us what you need made.

sections.heading: Best sellers
sections.subheading: Curated by us — the site records no online transactions.

sections.heading: Craftsmanship you can ask about
sections.body:
We would rather show you the work than describe it. Ask about any piece — the timber, the joinery, the finish — and we will tell you exactly how it is put together before you commit to it.

Send a photograph of something you like and we will tell you honestly what we can match and what we cannot.

image.alt: A craftsman's hands running a hand plane along a timber board, a curl of shaving lifting from the blade in a sunlit workshop.
image.caption: Details make better homes

sections.heading: Direct from the manufacturer
sections.body:
You are dealing with the people who build the furniture rather than a reseller. Ask for a change to a size, a timber or a finish and the answer comes back from the workshop instead of from a catalogue.

Tell us the budget you have in mind and we will tell you what is realistic within it.

image.alt: The New Galaxy Furniture workshop floor — craftsmen at workbenches beneath the words "Furniture that feels like home".
image.caption: Furniture that feels like home

sections.heading: Built to your measurements
sections.body:
Send a measurement, a photograph or a rough sketch on WhatsApp. We will come back to you with what is possible, what it will cost and how long it will take — before anything is started.

Size, timber, finish and upholstery are all yours to choose.

image.alt: A custom walnut dining table set with upholstered chairs, styled with plants and pendant lights in a sunlit room.
image.caption:
Your space
Your furniture

secondaryImage.alt: A close view of a curved walnut chair back cradling a bouclé cushion.
secondaryImage.caption: A better fit for a better tomorrow

sections.heading: Showroom & workshop
sections.body:
Seeing a piece in person tells you more than any photograph — the weight of it, the grain, how a seat actually feels. Come and sit on it.

Message us before you visit and we will make sure the pieces you want to see are out on the floor.

image.alt: A living-room showroom setting — a large beige sofa, round walnut coffee table and plants beneath the words "Spaces people love".
image.caption: Spaces people love

sections.heading: Order or enquire on WhatsApp
sections.subheading: Send a photograph, a measurement, or just a question. Either number reaches us.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Call or message either number and you will reach us directly. If you would rather we came back to you, send what you need and we will reply with options.
